payload.title: India's Asian Games Performance: 2026 vs 2022

sections.heading: Overview
sections.body: At the Asian Games 2026 in Aichi-Nagoya, India secured 30 medals (4 gold, 12 silver, 14 bronze) by the end of September 26 [E1]. This placed India 10th in the medal standings [E2]. The intended use of this analysis is not specified (known unknown).

sections.heading: Players
sections.body: Esha Singh secured a silver medal in the women's 25m pistol event [E5]. Pincky Balhara earned a bronze medal in the women's -78kg Kurash event [E6]. Divyansh Panwar claimed a gold medal in the Men's 10m air rifle team shooting event [E13]. Harmanpreet Kaur won a gold medal in the Women's cricket tournament [E14].

sections.heading: Approaches and trends
sections.body: Additionally, Pincky Balhara earned a bronze in kurash and Divyansh Panwar and Harmanpreet Kaur each won gold in shooting and cricket respectively [E6][E13][E14].

citations.span: India continued its medal charge at the Asian Games 2026 in Aichi-Nagoya, with the country's tally reaching 30 medals: four gold, 12 silver and 14 bronze by the end of September 26.
India are currently placed 10th in the medal standings.
Esha Singh added the latest silver medal to India’s tally after finishing second in the women’s 25m pistol final.
Pincky Balhara then added a bronze in the women’s -78kg Kurash event after losing her semifinal against South Korea’s Mo Sumin.
